title: Bullnose
summary: The sun sets on another week at UrbanToronto, and on a new building upping the urban quotient in King West. Located just east of where the Kitchener Corridor steampunks its way through the air above King Street, 1071 King West has been designed to get the best out of its wedge-shaped lot with a dramatic bullnose. Clad in a warm red brick, the building basks in the late day afterglow.
